get.description:
Asks the server now (MCP tools/list). Works for a server started elsewhere too, if the URL answers.

Failures are part of the answer (error field), not an HTTP error: an unreachable server is a state.
The Angular shell builds its menu from this - disabled or failed modules show up greyed out.

delete.description: Deletes the collection with all points. Irreversible - the name must be sent twice.

409.description: a job runs already, writes locked, or no sources configured

post.description: Stops after the current file. Embedded files stay in the collection, nothing is deleted.

get.description: Sources, collections, store and embedder state, newest job. Qdrant down = reachable false, no error.
